about: The hangar moves by the game's own roof cycle (data/motion/hangar.json, written twice so the layer loops whole) and its bridge crane's trolley runs along the crane rails and back.

movers.name: crane_trolley_1
movers.from: The bridge crane's trolley, SCORE's own (the game stands it still): run 12 m west along the crane rails (lattice_ring_rib_3 and _4, x -12.6 to 12.6) and back at 0.3 m/s (data/checks/motion.json crane_trolley: ABUS's 20 m/min fast speed is 0.33), over two of the roof's rounds.
